equivalent: BASELINE_EQUIVALENT when |delta| <= 0.01 and the interval includes zero.
mixed: MIXED_EXTERNAL_SIGNAL when the overall positive numeric gate passes but cohort sign consistency fails.
negative: BASELINE_OUTPERFORMS_CD when delta < -0.01 and 95% upper bound < 0.
no_rescue: Secondary metrics, post-hoc subgroups, alternate horizons, changed features, or refitting cannot rescue the primary disposition.
primary: CD_ADDS_EXTERNAL_SIGNAL when delta > 0.02, 95% task-bootstrap lower bound > 0, ROC-AUC delta >= -0.005, and each included source cohort has positive PR-AUC delta.
